items.title: The Grizzlies have to waive or trade two more players from guaranteed deals (Jaylen Wells is partial guaranteed but not going anywhere) to get into regular season roster compliance.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
The Grizzlies have to waive or trade two more players from guaranteed deals (Jaylen Wells is partial guaranteed but not going anywhere) to get into regular season roster compliance.

Memphis eats $7M in dead money for Jordan Hawkins for 26-27. Grizzlies are ~$38.4M under the tax.
